We need to produce test cases for exception scenarios not covered yet. Analyze recordLength method:

```
public int recordLength() {
    return ((((((name.length() + 10) + alg.length()) + 8)// time signed, fudge
     + 2)// 2 byte MAC length
     + algLengthMap.get(alg)) + 4)// original id, error
     + 8);// 2 byte error length, 6 byte max error field.
}
```

Potential exceptions:

- NullPointerException if name is null (already covered)
- NullPointerException if alg is null (already covered)
- NullPointerException if algLengthMap.get(alg) returns null leading to NPE when unboxing to int (auto-unboxing). Actually algLengthMap.get(alg) returns Integer; if key not present, returns null, then adding null to int causes NPE. So scenario: alg not in map. That could be algorithm name not recognized.

- Also, name.length() could throw IllegalStateException? Name class length maybe returns int but if name is malformed? Not likely.

- alg.length() could also NPE if alg null (covered). Or if alg is a Name but not in map, still length works.

- Also, if algLengthMap is null? It's static final map initialized somewhere else; but could be null if static initializer fails. Not testable.

- Also, overflow? int overflow not exception.

Thus we need test case where alg is a Name not present in algLengthMap, causing NPE due to unboxing null.

Also test case where algLengthMap contains null mapping? Not typical.

Also test case where name length > 255? Name length method may return >255 but not exception.

Potential IllegalArgumentException if name length > 255? Not in method.

Thus we add test for unknown algorithm.

Also test for algLengthMap.get returning null leads to NullPointerException.

Also test for name being a Name object that throws exception on length (maybe a custom subclass). But we cannot easily.

Thus we add test case: algorithm string "unknown-alg." not defined constant. Use Name.fromConstantString? That will create Name but not in map.

Also test case where alg is valid Name but map contains null entry? Not possible.

Thus we produce new test case group "recordLength_exceptions" maybe same group? The existing group is "recordLength". Already includes null cases. We need additional case for unknown algorithm.

Add case with name "example.com.", algorithm "unknown-alg." expecting NullPointerException.

Also maybe test where algLengthMap.get returns negative? Not exception.

Thus final JSON includes new case.

Make sure format matches schema: array of objects with group and cases.

We could add to same group "recordLength" but avoid duplication—they already have cases. We can add new case to same group.

Thus output JSON with group "recordLength" and cases array includes new case.

But must avoid duplication: new case not already present.

Thus produce:

{
 "group": "recordLength",
 "cases": [
   {
     "input": [{"parameter":"name","value":"example.com."},{"parameter":"algorithm","value":"unknown-alg."}],
     "expected":"NullPointerException",
     "description":"Algorithm Name not present in algLengthMap should cause NullPointerException due to autounboxing of null."
   }
 ]
}
